title.es: Las preguntas detrás de la pregunta

es: Reconocer si una pregunta de entrevista es de motivación, de experiencia pasada o hipotética y qué busca el comité.

teaching.en: The panel asks every candidate why they want the scholarship.
teaching.es: El comité pregunta a cada candidato por qué quiere la beca.
teaching.explanationEs: Why do you want…? es una pregunta de motivación: busca tus razones.
segments: The panel asks every candidate
why they want the scholarship.
teaching.audioText: The panel asks every candidate why they want the scholarship.

teaching.en: Tell me about a time when you led a team: this question helps the panel assess your past behaviour.
teaching.es: Cuéntame una vez en que lideraste un equipo: esta pregunta ayuda al comité a evaluar tu conducta pasada.
teaching.explanationEs: Tell me about a time when + pasado pide un hecho real, no una opinión.
segments: Tell me about a time when you led a team:
this question helps the panel assess your past behaviour.
teaching.audioText: Tell me about a time when you led a team: this question helps the panel assess your past behaviour.

teaching.en: A hypothetical question such as What would you do if the bus did not arrive? shows how you think.
teaching.es: Una pregunta hipotética como ¿Qué harías si el autobús no llegara? muestra cómo piensas.
teaching.explanationEs: What would you do if + pasado: se responde con would + tu decisión.
segments: A hypothetical question such as What would you do if
the bus did not arrive? shows how you think.
teaching.audioText: A hypothetical question such as What would you do if the bus did not arrive? shows how you think.

teaching.en: Your answer to a motivation question should reveal a clear reason, not only a wish.
teaching.es: Tu respuesta a una pregunta de motivación debe revelar una razón clara, no solo un deseo.
teaching.explanationEs: Reveal: dejar ver algo; una razón concreta convence más que «me gusta».
segments: Your answer to a motivation question should reveal
a clear reason, not only a wish.
teaching.audioText: Your answer to a motivation question should reveal a clear reason, not only a wish.

teaching.en: A good candidate names one strength and gives one example.
teaching.es: Un buen candidato nombra un punto fuerte y da un ejemplo.
teaching.explanationEs: Strength + example: la cualidad sola no convence; el ejemplo la prueba.
segments: A good candidate names one
strength and gives one example.
teaching.audioText: A good candidate names one strength and gives one example.

prompt.es: ¿De qué tipo es esta pregunta?

choices.text: Past experience question
Hypothetical question
Motivation question

feedback.es: Why… pregunta por razones: es una pregunta de motivación. No pide una historia pasada ni imagina una situación.

hint.es: Mira cómo empieza: why pregunta por razones.

origin.text: Why do you want to study abroad?

prompt.es: Completa: «Cuéntame sobre una vez que lideraste un equipo.»

feedback.es: Tell me about a time when… es la fórmula de las preguntas de experiencia: lleva about.

hint.es: Es la preposición que sigue a tell me y equivale a «sobre».

origin.text: Tell me ___ a time when you led a team.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Qué harías si perdieras el autobús?»

answer.text: What would you do if you missed the bus

feedback.es: La pregunta hipotética lleva would en la principal y pasado después de if.

hint.es: Would va tras what; después de if se usa el pasado.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada pregunta con lo que busca el comité.

pairs: Why do you want this scholarship?
Tell me about a time when you solved a problem.
What would you do if a teammate left?
What is your biggest strength?

feedback.es: Cada pregunta tiene su intención: motivación busca razones, experiencia busca hechos, hipotética busca decisiones y strength busca una cualidad probada.

pairs: Why do you want this scholarship?
Tell me about a time when you solved a problem.
What would you do if a teammate left?
What is your biggest strength?

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué tipo de respuesta pide la pregunta.

choices.text: A real story from the past, with a result.
A plan for the future.
A reason for applying.

feedback.es: Tell me about a time when… pide un hecho real y su resultado: qué hiciste y qué pasó.

origin.audio: Tell me about a time when you helped a classmate. What did you do, and what happened?

prompt.es: ¿Qué debe contener una buena respuesta a esta pregunta?

choices.text: A story from last year.
A decision explained with would.
A reason for wanting the scholarship.

feedback.es: La pregunta es hipotética: se contesta con una decisión (I would…) y su razón, no con una historia real.

origin.text: Ana: What would you do if the group could not agree?

prompt.es: Clasifica la pregunta de la entrevista.

choices.text: Motivation question
Hypothetical question
Past experience question

feedback.es: Tell me about a time when… pide un hecho pasado. No pregunta por razones ni imagina una situación.

origin.text: Tell me about a time when you managed your money well.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué quiere saber el comité.

choices.text: The candidate's reasons and goals.
What the candidate did last year.
How the candidate would solve a problem.

feedback.es: Las dos preguntas piden razones y objetivos: es el terreno de la motivación. No piden una historia pasada ni una hipótesis.

origin.audio: Why do you think you are the right candidate? What will this scholarship change for you?

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Qué harías si…?» «la beca» «evaluar tu conducta pasada»

feedback.es: Would abre la pregunta hipotética, scholarship es la beca y assess es evaluar lo que hiciste.

sentences: What ___ you do if the bus did not arrive?
The panel wants to ___ your past behaviour.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Cuéntame sobre una vez en que aprendiste algo difícil.»

answer.text: Tell me about a time when you learned something difficult

feedback.es: La pregunta de experiencia usa tell me about a time when + pasado (learned).

prompt.es: ¿Qué busca el comité con esta pregunta?

choices.text: To hear about a real past event.
To see how you make decisions.
To learn why you want the place.

feedback.es: What would you do if… es hipotética: el comité quiere ver cómo decides, no un hecho real ni tus razones para solicitar.

origin.text: What would you do if you disagreed with your team leader?

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué tipo de pregunta hizo el comité.

choices.text: A hypothetical question.
A motivation question.
A question about a real past event.

feedback.es: Tell me about a time when… es una pregunta de experiencia y Sara contesta con un hecho pasado.

origin.audio: The panel asked Sara: Tell me about a time when you felt nervous. She answered with a story from her first day at school.

prompt.es: Completa: «Un buen candidato da un ejemplo.»

feedback.es: Un ejemplo prueba la cualidad que nombras: sin él, la respuesta queda vacía.

origin.text: A good candidate gives one ___.

es: Resumir en una frase las preguntas de una entrevista con enquire about, want to know, be asked to y probe.

teaching.en: The panel enquired about my volunteer work and asked me to describe one project.
teaching.es: El comité preguntó por mi trabajo voluntario y me pidió que describiera un proyecto.
teaching.explanationEs: Enquire about + nombre resume una pregunta sobre un tema en un solo verbo.
segments: The panel enquired about my volunteer work
and asked me to describe one project.
teaching.audioText: The panel enquired about my volunteer work and asked me to describe one project.

teaching.en: They wanted to know whether I could work at weekends.
teaching.es: Querían saber si podía trabajar los fines de semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Wanted to know + whether + sujeto + verbo: una pregunta de sí o no, sin did ni inversión.
segments: They wanted to know whether
I could work at weekends.
teaching.audioText: They wanted to know whether I could work at weekends.

teaching.en: The panel wanted to probe my reasons, so I was asked to describe them in detail.
teaching.es: El comité quiso indagar en mis razones, así que me pidieron que las describiera con detalle.
teaching.explanationEs: Probe es seguir preguntando sobre lo mismo; be asked to + verbo recoge una petición.
segments: The panel wanted to probe my reasons, so
I was asked to describe them in detail.
teaching.audioText: The panel wanted to probe my reasons, so I was asked to describe them in detail.

teaching.en: In a report, I keep what the panel will want to know and skip the small talk.
teaching.es: En un informe conservo lo que el comité querrá saber y omito la charla.
teaching.explanationEs: Un informe resume el sentido y conserva lo que quiere saber el lector; no copia la conversación.
segments: In a report, I keep what the panel will
want to know and skip the small talk.
teaching.audioText: In a report, I keep what the panel will want to know and skip the small talk.

teaching.en: A concise report says: They asked why I had applied and how long I had worked there.
teaching.es: Un informe conciso dice: preguntaron por qué había solicitado y cuánto tiempo llevaba trabajando allí.
teaching.explanationEs: Con wh- el orden es afirmativo (why I had applied) y el tiempo retrocede.
segments: A concise report says: They asked why I had
applied and how long I had worked there.
teaching.audioText: A concise report says: They asked why I had applied and how long I had worked there.

prompt.es: Completa: «Querían saber si podía trabajar los sábados.»

feedback.es: Wanted to know + whether/if resume una pregunta de sí o no, y después va sujeto + verbo.

hint.es: Es la conjunción de las preguntas de sí o no, sin did ni inversión.

origin.text: They wanted to know ___ I could work on Saturdays.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo se resume la pregunta «What is your experience?»?

choices.text: They enquired about my experience.
They enquired about what is my experience.
They wanted to know what was my experience.

feedback.es: Enquire about va con un nombre: my experience. Las otras opciones mantienen la inversión de la pregunta (is my experience / was my experience).

hint.es: Enquire about lleva un nombre, sin verbo de pregunta.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me pidieron que describiera un proyecto.»

answer.text: I was asked to describe a project

feedback.es: Be asked to + verbo base resume una petición de la entrevista.

prompt.es: ¿Qué informe transmite bien la pregunta?

choices.text: They wanted to know why did I apply for the scholarship.
They wanted to know why I had applied for the scholarship.
They wanted to know that I applied for the scholarship.

feedback.es: La pregunta con why se resume sin inversión y con el tiempo retrocedido: why I had applied. Why did I apply mantiene did y la inversión; that I applied convierte la pregunta en afirmación.

origin.text: Panel: Why did you apply for this scholarship?

prompt.es: Completa: «Me preguntaron por mi experiencia.»

feedback.es: Enquire about + nombre: es la forma de resumir una pregunta sobre un tema.

origin.text: They enquired ___ my experience.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué quería saber el comité.

choices.text: Why Leo preferred nights to days.
Whether Leo had taught English before.
If Leo was available at night and the length of his English studies.

feedback.es: Querían saber si Leo podía trabajar de noche y cuánto tiempo había estudiado inglés.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Querían saber si podía empezar en mayo.»

answer.text: They wanted to know whether I could start in May

feedback.es: El informe de una pregunta de sí o no usa wanted to know whether + sujeto + verbo.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo se resume esta petición de la entrevista?

choices.text: I was asked to describe my last job.
I was asking to describe my last job.
I asked them to describe my last job.

feedback.es: La petición recibida se resume con I was asked to + verbo. Was asking cambia la forma y I asked them cambia quién pregunta.

origin.text: Panel: Describe your last job.

prompt.es: Completa: «preguntaron por» «querían saber si» «me pidieron que»

feedback.es: Enquired about introduce un tema, wanted to know if/whether introduce una pregunta de sí o no y asked to + verbo una petición.

sentences: They wanted to know ___ I spoke English.
I was ___ to describe a project.

prompt.es: Resume en una frase la pregunta del comité.

answer.text: They wanted to know whether I spoke French.
accepted: They wanted to know whether I spoke French.
They wanted to know if I spoke French.
They asked whether I spoke French.

origin.text: El comité preguntó: «Do you speak French?». Cuéntalo después en una frase.

prompt.es: ¿Qué informe es fiel a la pregunta?

choices.text: They wanted to know how long did I work with children.
They wanted to know how long I had worked with children.
They enquired about how long have I worked with children.

feedback.es: Con how long se usa orden afirmativo y el verbo retrocede: how long I had worked. Las otras dos mantienen la estructura de pregunta.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hizo el entrevistador después.

choices.text: He asked the candidate to leave.
He offered the job at once.
He asked more questions about the decision.

feedback.es: Probed my decision significa que siguió preguntando sobre esa decisión: por qué esperó una semana.

feedback.es: Probe es indagar: seguir preguntando sobre un mismo tema.

es: Comprobar si el relato de una entrevista es fiel a las preguntas originales y detectar cuándo omite, exagera o distorsiona.

teaching.en: A faithful report keeps the meaning of the original question, even if the words change.
teaching.es: Un informe fiel mantiene el significado de la pregunta original, aunque cambien las palabras.
teaching.explanationEs: Fiel no es copiar: es conservar el sentido.
segments: A faithful report keeps the meaning of the
original question, even if the words change.
teaching.audioText: A faithful report keeps the meaning of the original question, even if the words change.

teaching.en: The panel did not challenge his answer; it only asked for an example, so Tom should not distort what happened.
teaching.es: El comité no cuestionó su respuesta, solo pidió un ejemplo, así que Tom no debería distorsionar lo ocurrido.
teaching.explanationEs: Challenge es poner en duda; pedir un ejemplo no lo es. Distort cambia el sentido.
segments: The panel did not challenge his answer; it only asked
for an example, so Tom should not distort what happened.
teaching.audioText: The panel did not challenge his answer; it only asked for an example, so Tom should not distort what happened.

teaching.en: Do not omit the condition: the panel asked if he could work at weekends only in summer.
teaching.es: No omitas la condición: el comité preguntó si podía trabajar los fines de semana solo en verano.
teaching.explanationEs: Omit: dejar fuera un dato; aquí la condición only in summer cambia la pregunta.
segments: Do not omit the condition: the panel asked if
he could work at weekends only in summer.
teaching.audioText: Do not omit the condition: the panel asked if he could work at weekends only in summer.

teaching.en: Saying that the panel demanded an answer would exaggerate what happened; they only asked him to think.
teaching.es: Decir que el comité exigió una respuesta sería exagerar lo ocurrido: solo le pidieron que pensara.
teaching.explanationEs: Exaggerate convierte una pregunta en una exigencia: sube el grado.
segments: Saying that the panel demanded an answer would exaggerate
what happened; they only asked him to think.
teaching.audioText: Saying that the panel demanded an answer would exaggerate what happened; they only asked him to think.

teaching.en: An accurate report uses a precise verb: the panel may ask, enquire or press for details.
teaching.es: Un informe preciso usa un verbo exacto: el comité puede preguntar, indagar o insistir pidiendo detalles.
teaching.explanationEs: Ask es neutro; enquire about introduce un tema; press añade insistencia.
segments: An accurate report uses a precise verb: the
panel may ask, enquire or press for details.
teaching.audioText: An accurate report uses a precise verb: the panel may ask, enquire or press for details.

It changes the person.

es: Responder una pregunta de conducta con situación, acción, resultado y lección, y una hipotética con would, un motivo y un ejemplo.

teaching.en: When the club lost its hall, I took the initiative and asked the library for a room.
teaching.es: Cuando el club perdió su sala, tomé la iniciativa y pedí una sala a la biblioteca.

initiative and asked the library for a room.
teaching.audioText: When the club lost its hall, I took the initiative and asked the library for a room.

teaching.explanationEs: Present perfect (have done) para la experiencia general; pasado simple para el detalle (worked).
segments: I can handle complaints because I have done it before:

prompt.es: Escribe dos respuestas: una de conducta y una hipotética.

answer.text: Last year, our school football team had no coach, so I took the initiative. I asked a teacher for help, and I organised the timetable for all the players. As a result, the team played every match, and I learned that asking for help early solves problems. If a volunteer did not come to an event, I would speak to that person first, because I would want to understand what happened. Then I would find another volunteer, so the event could start on time and the guests would not notice the problem.
